tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Why did the company lose money?"
B builds the answer from the tiles. The blue tile shows two verbs: choose the one that goes with the noun (make a mistake, take a risk) and put it into the right form.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Take a risk. The verb and the noun belong together.
